details: Elevators, Escalators & Ramps: The newly reconstructed stone temple complex is equipped with elevators, escalators, and wheelchair ramps to assist senior citizens and differently-abled pilgrims in bypassing staircases leading to the cave sanctum.
Free Wheelchairs: Free wheelchair assistance services are available at the hilltop helpdesks.
Priority Darshan Entry: Senior citizens presenting valid age proof (Aadhaar Card) can request priority darshan entry at designated queue gates.
